lodash, 19,545 B on the mfazones-main page: the full build; lodash-es with named imports ships only what is used.
689,889 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (61 packages, 465 modules).
